events.title: 7th Annual Cowboy Church Power & Prayer Classic Car & Bike Show 2026
events.description:
Rev up your engines and join us for the 7th Annual Cowboy Church Classic Car & Bike Show – Power & Prayer 2026! 
Whether you're showing off your favorite ride or simply coming to enjoy the incredible lineup of classic cars and motorcycles, there's something for everyone. This family-friendly event features food, prizes, a 50/50 raffle, Hot Wheels Car Show and a coloring contest for the kids, and trophies for outstanding entries. Spectating is free, and all makes and models are welcome. Car and Bike entry fee of $15.00 
Start your day by worshiping with us at our 10:00 a.m. service, then stay for an afternoon of fellowship, fun, and horsepower from Noon to 3:00 p.m. We look forward to seeing you there!

Registration Link Coming Soon!

events.title: Sunday Message: Why Can't I Let Go?
events.description:
What if the thing you're holding onto the tightest is the very thing keeping you from experiencing real freedom? 
This Sunday at Cowboy Church, we'll continue our WHY? series with a message called "Why Can't I Let Go?" We'll explore one of Jesus' most surprising conversations with a successful young man who had everything most people dream of—yet still sensed something was missing. Along the way, we'll discover what Jesus teaches about trust, priorities, and even the role our possessions can play in capturing our hearts.
Join us this Sunday, July 26 at 10:00 a.m. at Cowboy Church (Hwy. 65 & Crosstown Blvd., Ham Lake, MN). 
Everyone is welcome—whether you wear a cowboy hat, baseball cap, or no hat at all!
